verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's key element, the black-and-white praying-hands photo. Only white cloud outlines and plus marks are left, as near-invisible ghosts on white in the left half, so half the banner is dead space and the design is no longer recognisable; the quote text is readable and centred on the right but crowded toward the top edge. B is slightly worse because it adds a stray clipped grey bar along the top edge above the headline (a leftover sliver of the photo), while A at least keeps the plus marks faintly visible.
